title: Fei-Fei Li's World Labs raised $200M from Autodesk, part of a larger round; the companies are exploring integrating World Labs' AI models in Autodesk products (Rebecca Bellan/TechCrunch)
summary: Rebecca Bellan / TechCrunch: Fei-Fei Li's World Labs raised $200M from Autodesk, part of a larger round; the companies are exploring integrating World Labs' AI models in Autodesk products — Fei-Fei Li's World Labs has secured a $200 million investment from software design giant Autodesk.
